translations.web: I will make them and the places around my hill a blessing. I will cause the shower to come down in its season. There will be showers of blessing.
translations.bsb: I will make them and the places around My hill a blessing. I will send down showers in season—showers of blessing.
translations.kjv: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in his season; there shall be showers of blessing.
translations.asv: And I will make them and the places round about my hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.
